description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink open source project and manages the creation, editing, updating, deletion, and linking of keywords within the project. It provides UI initialization, handling of user actions, and interaction with the database for keyword management.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Generic empty class used for various data objects within the script.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Class for managing test projects, used here for keyword association.

classes.name: tree
classes.description: Class for handling project hierarchy, used to retrieve project info.

classes.name: tlInputParameter
classes.description: Class defining input parameter types and validation.

classes.name: tl
classes.description: Class with constants such as OK status code.

classes.name: tlObject
classes.description: Class providing helper functions like getDBTables.

methods.name: initEnv
methods.description: Initializes environment variables and parameters for the page context.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Sets up the GUI variables for creating a new keyword.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Prepares the GUI with existing keyword data for editing purposes.

methods.name: do_create
methods.description: Creates a new keyword in the project database.

methods.name: do_update
methods.description: Update an existing keyword with new data.

methods.name: cfl
methods.description: Sets up the GUI for creating and linking a keyword.

methods.name: do_cfl
methods.description: Creates and links a keyword to a test case version.

methods.name: getKeywordErrorMessage
methods.description: Provides user-friendly messages based on error codes related to keyword operations.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Initializes the GUI object with project and user data for display.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if a user has sufficient rights to view or modify keywords.
